title: Commonwealth Shared Scholarships
institution: Commonwealth Scholarship Commission in the UK
field: Master's study (courses published by the CSC)
about: Commonwealth Shared Scholarships fund Master's study at participating UK universities in 2027/28. Applications open on 10 November 2026 and close at 16:00 GMT on 8 December 2026; candidates must also apply separately to their university course.
requirements: For Master's courses only, not for undergraduate study
Candidates must also apply separately to a university course
Courses and participating UK universities for 2027 are published before the application opening date
card_alt: Card for Commonwealth Shared Scholarships from the Commonwealth Scholarship Commission in the UK, United Kingdom, deadline 8 Dec 2026.
